answer: An adversary running 155 aliases hence needs 155 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are recorded in velvet, expire in haven, and relic lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 30 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3877 identities would post 1172 proofs and burn roughly 61 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
